# Pwnapple (vendored)

iOS 6 skeuomorphic Compose component kit by Heretek AI, MIT licensed (see LICENSE).
Source: https://github.com/Heretek-AI/pwnapple (commit 54361ee, "initial release").

Local changes:
- Build files replaced (no publishing config; versions pinned in this repo).
- `IosTableCell`, `IosButton`, `IosBackButton`: keyboard / D-pad *focus* is drawn like *pressed*,
  so the kit is usable with a gamepad.
